name: Post Post-Mortem
subtitle: Why a post overperformed or flopped, in plain terms.
summary: Pulls a post's impressions, likes, replies and reposts, compares them to your baseline, and explains the result through concrete growth levers (hook, format, timing), ending with what to repeat or avoid. No link needed: it can pick your most recent post that already has numbers.
howToAsk: Why did this post do so well?
get: the numbers vs your baseline and a lever-by-lever explanation.
chips: Very fresh posts have no metrics yet
launchPrompt: Pick my most recent post that already has numbers and do a post-mortem on it: how it did against my baseline, why it performed that way, and what to repeat. If my analytics are still syncing, tell me and use my recent posts instead.
